svg.title: Adaptive Delivery: main-thread goal and bounded assignments
svg.desc: The main thread retains preflight, the native goal, acceptance, user decisions, repair accounting and completion. It delegates bounded implementation on a difficulty-selected route and verification on a separate explicit route. Verification delegates independent review, which retains its own readers. Results return through their capability boundaries. Two implementation repair attempts are shared across findings; assessment corrections preserve history without resetting that allowance.
svg.text: Adaptive Delivery
One native goal in the main thread. Bounded implementation and capabilities.
Main thread · native goal owner
Read-only preflight · readiness · acceptance · user decisions · completion
Implementation difficulty selects its route. Consequence risk selects assurance.
Goal ≤4,000 characters · coordination in the skill · native continuation on Codex and Claude
Assignment / checks and results
Candidate and checks / combined evidence
Bounded implementation agent
Implement or repair within the assignment.
Return changed files, checks and blockers.
Difficulty-selected model and effort · no goal ownership
Verification coordinator · when selected
Bind acceptance and candidate evidence.
Invoke review and reconcile the complete result.
Explicit coordinator route · capability internals retained
Review coordinator → independent readers
Review retains its own delegation and reader routes.
The main thread keeps the evidence
Two implementation repair attempts by default.
Corrections retain prior assessment history.
Feedback continues the same goal and allowance.
Completion requires current checks, acceptance coverage and selected clear verification. It grants no new authority.
Darrow · current contract · 2026-10-02
